title: Three-node evidence flow
summary: An original technical diagram fixture with exactly three labeled nodes and two directed edges, designed to verify topology and literal node copy without external iconography.

record.title: Three-node evidence flow prompt
record.purpose: Provide a bounded diagram worked example with observable node count, edge direction and literal labels.
record.sourceText: A left-to-right three-node flow labeled INTENT, CONSTRAINT and EVIDENCE.

prompt.positive: A left-to-right technical flow with exactly three rounded rectangular nodes labeled INTENT, CONSTRAINT and EVIDENCE, exactly two directed connectors, one concise legend, high-contrast accessible palette.
prompt.negative: No fourth node, no crossing edge, no icon, no logo, no watermark, no external diagram asset.

subject: exactly three labeled technical nodes
composition: single left-to-right row with exactly two directed connectors
technical: literal labels INTENT, CONSTRAINT and EVIDENCE
one legend below the node row
constraints: topology must remain three nodes and two edges

variants.label: Baseline topology
variants.change: No variation; retain the checked three-node topology.
variants.positive: Retain exactly three nodes, two edges and the three literal labels.

criteria.check: Exactly three nodes and two directed edges are present in left-to-right order.
criteria.evidence: The deterministic SVG exposes one nodes group and one edges group with the declared topology.

knownRisks: A geometric fixture does not establish semantic correctness for another workflow.
evaluation.nextExperiment: Human review may compare connector spacing without changing topology or copy.

changeLog: v1: create an original deterministic diagram prompt fixture.

visualSpec.composition: Exactly three rounded nodes form one left-to-right row joined by exactly two directed connectors; one legend sits below.
